end.summary:
Read velocity-time graphs: slope represents acceleration.
Interpreted rising, flat, and falling graph sections as changing, constant, and decreasing velocity.
Distinguished position-time flat lines from velocity-time flat lines.
Calculated average velocity, displacement from area, and acceleration from slope.
Used motion-story and cricket run-rate analogies to connect graph steepness with rate of change.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs as motion stories rather than pictures of a path. Ira correctly used slope for acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph for displacement, including a triangular area calculation. No misconception remained at the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to describe one graph aloud using the words position, velocity, acceleration, and displacement.
